diagrams.title: System Overview
diagrams.description: Every service in docker-compose.yml and how they talk: clients reach yolo-api, which calls Triton over gRPC and OpenSearch; the opt-in profiles add the curation workers, segmenter, VLM, trainer, evaluator, MLflow and monitoring. Start here.

diagrams.title: Backend Modules
diagrams.description: How src/ is organized: src/main.py mounts the core and curation routers, which are thin adapters over FastAPI-free services, configured by the src/config dataclasses. The curation workers import the same detection and labeling services.

diagrams.title: Data Model
diagrams.description: The OpenSearch indexes: the curation pool (images, items, classes, confirmed labels, settings and projection state, plus the JSON class registry) and the separate visual-search indexes the core /ingest route writes.

diagrams.title: Core Inference
diagrams.description: What /detect, /faces, /embed and /ocr do: CPU preprocessing in the API, then TensorRT models in Triton. OCR is a single call to the ocr_pipeline Python BLS model, which runs detection and recognition inside Triton.

diagrams.title: Curation Pipeline
diagrams.description: The active-learning loop: ingest with your item detector, PE-Core embeddings, clustering, VLM suggestions, human review, export, training, bake-off and promote, with probe predictions feeding the next review cycle.

diagrams.title: Region Cascade
diagrams.description: The detection worker's cascade for the active region profile: region detector, then the segmenter leg, then an OCR text-hinted re-segment; every candidate is VLM-verified and its text read. Shows the code as it is today; multi-region support and editable prompts/profiles are coming soon, and this diagram will be updated when they land.

diagrams.title: Training and Promote
diagrams.description: The API and the trainer exchange only files on the shared /jobs volume. The GPU arbiter claims GPUs for the run and releases them afterwards; promote checks the eval gate, writes the model repository and loads the model into Triton.
